reason: I already pay for field-service software plus lead fees, and I'm not adding another subscription to a tool nobody outside the owner's own company has paid for yet. I don't have time to be a guinea pig.
objection: No outside customer has paid for it yet, so I'd be the test case. If it drops a lead or messes up my schedule, I lose real jobs, and I already pay for software that does scheduling and invoices.
would_change_my_mind: Proof from other companies like mine, with real numbers on faster lead response, plus a direct integration with my existing scheduling software and lead sources so I don't switch anything.
